title: EICAR anti-malware test file
description: The EICAR test file is a harmless, standardised string that every antivirus product is designed to flag, which makes it a safe way to exercise the hash workflow. The three hashes below identify the same 68-byte file. Hash lookups only send the digest to a provider you explicitly select — never the file. Use the 'Local tools' page to hash a copy of the file yourself and confirm the SHA-256 matches.

indicators.note: SHA-256 of the EICAR test file.
SHA-1 of the EICAR test file.
MD5 of the EICAR test file.

notes: Without any API keys only local analysis runs, and it recognises these as the standard test file. With a key, selected providers report what they have seen, and the keyed results stay labelled 'Provider claim'.
A hash carries no file-type information by itself — file type comes from a provider that has seen the file, or from hashing the file locally.
